description:

Goal: Promote the artifact to production and ensure it is removed from the development repository.

Instructions:
1. Open the Artifactory UI (http://localhost:8082).
2. Navigate to the Artifacts browser.
3. Locate 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' inside 'dev-libs-local' at path 'org/apache/commons/commons-lang3/3.14.0/'.
4. Use the 'Move' action to move the artifact to the 'prod-libs-local' repository, keeping the same path structure.
5. Verify the artifact is now in 'prod-libs-local' and no longer in 'dev-libs-local'.
